label: 💥 Blast (0.8 beta)
description:
Fourteen melodic FM models on one machine. A '90s PC Soundblaster engine, built on the Yamaha OPL2.

[[video]]

SIN - Sine: clean two-operator FM, modulator depth on COLOR
HLF - Half-sine: hollow, reedy carrier
ABS - Absolute sine: folded wave, octave-rich and bright
PLS - Pulse: nasal, square-edged carrier
BAS - Bass: short FM slap over a round body
PIA - Piano: bright bark settling into a round tone
MAR - Marimba: fundamental plus tuned overtone, mallet click
GLK - Glockenspiel: bright strike with a quiet high partial
BRS - Brass: slow swell into a sustained brass
ACC - Accordion: two detuned half-sine reeds
STR - Strings: feedback saw modulator with a bowed attack
STL - Steel drum: hollow ring with a semitone blip
TMP - Timpani: felt thud and a long low membrane
ZAP - Laser: four-octave pitch fall

SHAPE picks the model
COLOR is the FM depth
SWEEP is the fixed modulator:carrier ratio, 1:2 to 15X
CONTOUR shapes the model

[GATE] = on
BRS, ACC, and STR: sustain
PIA, MAR, GLK and STL: delays the damper so long notes ring.

[PUNCH] = on
SIN, HLF, ABS, PLS, MAR, BRS and STR: vibrato
BAS, PIA, GLK and STL: tremolo
ACC: vibrato and tremolo
TMP and ZAP: nothing
